scope: One source-independent table and search configuration across all complete sources. Host predictions and artifact diagnostics, not a new audio release or actual emulator proof.
timing_scope: Per-source times include preparation, workset serialization, C execution, full rendering and artifact diagnostics. A resumed attempt is not a fresh full conversion benchmark; its wall time is reported separately. TRD assembly/emulator execution is separate.
decision: Reject unconditional midpoint-joint replacement:4 whole-source SNR/RMS regressions versus half-joint, a new approximately1996-Hz tonal silence line, and numerical AM/delay/coherent-error regressions. No new Fuse run is warranted for this rejected host candidate. The lower silence RMS does not establish absence of added background.
